biothings.name: nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 1
biothings.summary: The protein encoded by this gene is a transcriptional activator involved in sex determination. The encoded protein binds DNA as a monomer. Defects in this gene are a cause of XY sex reversal with or without adrenal failure as well as adrenocortical insufficiency without ovarian defect. [provided by RefSeq, Jul 2008].
biothings.alias: AD4BP, ELP, FTZ1, FTZF1, POF7, SF-1, SF1, SPGF8, SRXX4, SRXY3, hSF-1

biothings.name: NR5A1 5' promoter region
biothings.summary: This locus spans the 5' promoter region of the the nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 1 (NR5A1/SF-1) gene. This promoter is regulated by binding of upstream transcription factors (USF1 and 2) to a conserved E-box, as well as binding by SRY-box factors and autoregulation by Nr5a1/Sf-1 protein. This region is hypomethylated and over-expressed in endometriosis. [provided by RefSeq, Aug 2016]

biothings.name: SRY promoter region
biothings.summary: This region represents the promoter of the sex determining region Y (SRY) gene. Transcription of this promoter is stimulated by Wilms tumor 1, nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 1 (NR5A1/SF1), and transcription factor CP2, and may be downregulated by cyclic AMP. [provided by RefSeq, Jun 2016]

biothings.name: SOX9 enhancer enh5
biothings.summary: This region contains an enhancer that is thought to regulate expression of the SRY-box 9 (SOX9) gene, located approximately 320 kb downstream. Activity of this sequence is stimulated by Sox9, sex determining region Y (Sry), and nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 1 (Nr5a1/Sf1). [provided by RefSeq, Jun 2016]

biothings.name: AMH 5' regulatory region
biothings.summary: This record represents the 5' regulatory region of the anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) gene and includes the proximal promoter as well as more distal regulatory elements. The proximal promoter is regulated by binding of nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 1 (Nr5a1/Sf1) to a conserved recognition site. SRY-box 9, sex determining region Y, forkhead box L2, and GATA binding protein 4 may synergize with Nr5a1/Sf1 to increase gene expression, while binding by Wilms tumor 1 results in repression of activity. This region is stimulated by signalling by bone morphogenetic proteins, vitamin D, estrogen, and protein kinase A/cyclic AMP. [provided by RefSeq, Sep 2016]
